standouts.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 12 to Aug 3 (+53%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−1% to −8.3%), in three waves, with the 50-day average and the Jan 28 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 23, 2025 to Dec 9, 2025 and a pullback of 0.75 of them to the Mar 12 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−18%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+26%) says wave 3 is under way.

GXO.gist: A falling stock; the buy comes only when it clears the Aug 28 high.

standouts.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Apr 7, 2025 to Feb 9 (+119%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−8.4% to −21%), in three waves, with wave C equal to wave A and the Aug 12, 2024 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−37%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+38%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.text: Price sits on the Mar 30 low, the 50% retracement of the Jul 17–Sep 24 drop and the Jun 17 low, where 7 levels of 2 kinds meet.
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.

against.head: Weekly chart: declining
against.text: On the weekly chart price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.

against.head: A breakout that failed (upthrust)
against.text: On Oct 22 it poked over the ceiling of its trading range and closed back inside: buyers were trapped, a Wyckoff upthrust.
against.learn: A poke over a range's ceiling that closes back inside: buyers trapped before a fall (Wyckoff).

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: A swing high under the one before and a swing low under the one before: the steps of a downtrend.

GXO.take: GXO: it is bouncing inside a downtrend; the buy waits for a daily close above the Aug 28 high, the first sign the decline is over. It is turning up from its wave-2 zone on the weekly chart, and it sits on stacked support. Against it, the weekly chart is in its declining stage. The desk stays out until the trigger's close says otherwise.
GXO.change: Until a daily close above +1%, the decline is intact and there is no trade; once in, a daily close below −2%, under the Aug 28 high, proves it wrong. The case against, that the weekly chart is in its declining stage, fails on a weekly close above +3.1%, the 30-week average.
